body:
SO I tried to write this freakin’thing twice now and it screwed up both times so I give up.  Basically for anyone who is still interested, I went 3-1 and lost my last game to Brian Rippetoe’s chesse Profit insert deck.  I beat Jon Chu and two random guys.  Thanks for reading and maybe next time I try to write a TR it won’t screw up.



Steven "Technology Illiterate" Lewis

summary: Steven Lewis went 3–1 at a tournament around September 2001 that the report does not name or place, beating Jon Chu and two others and losing his last game to Brian Rippetoe's Profit insert deck.
notes: Previously skipped for having no event; published per Bill 2026-10-25. The report gives no event, date, place, decks or finish (the author says two longer drafts were lost).

Event name derived: posted 24 September 2001; the author's home city is Nashville (d1545 'I left Nashville', d1687, d1224), so 'September 2001 Nashville tournament' (no such hub on the List). Place and month are not stated in the report; event_site left null. Could be another event (e.g. the 2001 DragonCon Open), but nothing in the report says so.
Format Premiere - Coruscant by date (September 2001), not stated.
'Jon Chu' mapped to [[Jonny Chu]] (Lewis's Nashville-area regular, d1687); Brian Rippetoe to the existing page. Order of the three wins not stated; the Rippetoe loss was the last (4th) game.
Author side in the Rippetoe game set Dark because Profit is a Light objective; no other sides known.
Title from the slug 'steven-sucks-at-trs' (self-deprecating, not withheld).
